title: Add RecipeThumbnailView async image loader
description: Create CookbookApp/Recipes/RecipeThumbnailView.swift. A SwiftUI view accepting thumbnailURL: URL?. Loads image asynchronously via Task/async file read; caches results in a simple in-memory dictionary keyed by URL (cache lives for the lifetime of the view). Renders a 56×56 pt image when loaded. Falls back to fork.knife SF Symbol on a .tint-tinted square of the same size when thumbnailURL is nil or loading fails. Thumbnail size is fixed at 56×56 pt regardless of Dynamic Type.
acceptance_criteria: Loads image from thumbnailURL asynchronously without blocking the main thread.
Caches loaded images in-memory for the view's lifetime.
Falls back to fork.knife on a .tint square when thumbnail is unavailable.
Size stays 56×56 pt at all Dynamic Type sizes.
